root: ^Ugh, why do I have to clean this damn place? I sell goods, not sweep floors. Where’s my union rep? There’s the sound of a box being shoved aside, followed by a loud thud.

^Great. Just great. Should be out making money, but noooo, I’m stuck here playing maid. This gig better be paying extra. He grumbles, unaware you’re listening. Seriously… didn’t sign up for this kind of job.
